Compare all candidate models on a train/test split

Source: R/comparison.R
compare_models.Rd

Runs Tucker3-CoDa, Tucker3-Direct, Lee-Carter, FDM, StMoMo-APC, RWD, ARIMA-perSeries, and ETS-Damped on the training data; evaluates on the holdout test set. Optionally builds an ensemble via inverse-MASE weighting and NNLS stacking.

Usage

compare_models(
  mx_array,
  pop_array,
  years,
  ages,
  groups,
  train_idx,
  test_idx,
  calib_coda,
  calib_direct,
  width = 5,
  calib_all = NULL,
  mx_eval_ref = NULL
)

Arguments

mx_array

3D array [n_a x n_t x n_g] of (smoothed) mortality rates.

pop_array

3D population exposure array.

years

Integer vector of years.

ages

Integer vector of age-group starts.

groups

data.frame with sex and quintile columns.

train_idx

Integer indices of training years.

test_idx

Integer indices of test years.

calib_coda

Output of calibrate_tucker3() with method="coda".

calib_direct

Output of calibrate_tucker3() with method="direct".

width

Age-group width (default 5).

calib_all

Output of calibrate_all_models() (NULL for defaults).

mx_eval_ref

Optional raw-scale array for MASE evaluation.

Value

Named list: results (data.table), fc_arrays, ens_best_k, ens_best_names, ens_best_weights.
